name: KubeContext
author: Nepomuk Software
description: Shows the active Kubernetes context in the bar, switches between contexts and namespaces across every kubeconfig in ~/.kube, and gives a short overview of the selected cluster.

barWidget.description: Current kubectl context in the bar, right-click to switch, extra kubeconfigs in ~/.kube grouped by file, plus nodes, pods and namespace of the selected cluster.

schema.label: Context name in the bar
schema.description: Shows the active context next to the icon. Ignored on vertical bars.

schema.label: Namespace in the bar
schema.description: Appends /namespace to the context label. Ignored when the context name is hidden or the bar is vertical.

schema.label: Maximum label length
schema.description: Longer context names are elided in the bar.

schema.label: Kubeconfig interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the kubeconfig is re-read so the bar follows a context changed in a terminal. Local file read, no network.

schema.label: Cluster interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often clusters are contacted while the panel is open. Nothing leaves the machine while it is closed.
